title: National Highway System bridge-deck area fair-or-better share reaches 96 percent
summary: DOT reports 96 percent of National Highway System bridge-deck area in fair or better condition in FY 2025, above the 95 percent target. Denominator: National Highway System bridge-deck area classified under the federal bridge-condition method.
key_findings: Finding: DOT reports 96 percent of National Highway System bridge-deck area in fair or better condition in FY 2025, above the 95 percent target.
Denominator: National Highway System bridge-deck area classified under the federal bridge-condition method.
Boundary: Deck area weights large bridges more heavily than a bridge count.

Boundary: The national measure does not attribute condition to one funding program.
